members: CREATE TABLE members (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, city TEXT)
INSERT INTO members (name, city) SELECT DISTINCT member_name, member_city FROM sales ORDER BY member_name
orders: CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, member_id INTEGER, item TEXT)
INSERT INTO orders SELECT order_id, (SELECT id FROM members WHERE name = member_name), item FROM sales
view: SELECT o.item, m.name, m.city FROM orders o JOIN members m ON m.id = o.member_id ORDER BY o.id

CREATE TABLE members (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, city TEXT NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO members (name, city) SELECT member_name, member_city FROM sales GROUP BY member_name, member_city
orders: CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, member_id INTEGER NOT NULL, item TEXT NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO orders (id, member_id, item) SELECT order_id, members.id, item FROM sales INNER JOIN members ON members.name = sales.member_name
view: select item, name, city from orders inner join members on members.id = orders.member_id order by orders.id;
